objective: Relate the frozen matched Brain/Opus Tool Discovery authority to an arbitrary finite explicit common tool boundary and prove that the common-authority discovery adapter preserves the entire boundary while hiding capability truth until safe probes.

proof_domain.identity_discovery: FOR_EACH_DECISION_EPOCH_THE_ADAPTER REPRESENTS_THE_EXACT COMPLEMENT_OF_THE_INITIAL_VISIBLE_SUBSET AS ONE HARNESS_OWNED_AUTHORITATIVE_DISCOVERY SOURCE__DISCOVER RETURNS ALL_AND_ONLY_THOSE PUBLIC_ROUTE_ROWS
proof_domain.capability_information: ACTUAL_CAPABILITY_SUPPORT_REMAINS PRIVATE HARNESS TRUTH AND IS REVEALED TO V4 ONLY ONE REQUESTED CAPABILITY AT A TIME THROUGH SAFE PROBE RECEIPTS
proof_domain.changing_ecosystem: A MATERIAL TOOL_VERSION_OR_BOUNDARY_CHANGE STARTS A NEW DECISION EPOCH__SAME_EPOCH EVIDENCE MAY TRANSFER__CROSS_EPOCH STALE EVIDENCE IS NOT INHERITED BY THE ADAPTER
proof_domain.constraint_scope: EXACT CONSTRAINT FILTERING IS A DETERMINISTIC DEPENDENCY BOUNDARY__THE PROOF USES V4'S DECLARED EXACT PREDICATE LANGUAGE AND DOES NOT CLAIM UPSTREAM NATURAL_LANGUAGE_CONSTRAINT_COMPILATION

formal_lemmas.statement: The frozen protocols require the same frozen tool authority/tool classes/external action authority for Brain and Opus; the adapter's tool_boundary is exactly that per-case authority and never substitutes the Brain-only registry.

For any finite explicit boundary E and arbitrary initially visible subset V, the adapter constructs one discovery source whose result is exactly E minus V, so after one successful DISCOVER visible identities equal E.
The public V4 state contains public route metadata but not the hidden capability matrix; each PROBE receipt reveals only the requested capability truth for one canonical tool at its current epoch.
Current verified V4 returns DISCOVER whenever the adapter's unqueried source exists, so no PROBE or SELECT occurs while any common-boundary identity remains hidden.

The adapter has at most one unqueried common-authority source per epoch; its atomic transition adds the exact hidden complement and the query receipt together, so discovery closure terminates with every boundary identity visible.

The adapter rejects duplicate identities and nonfinite costs; V4 filters availability/authorization/exact constraints then orders all remaining routes by finite cost and canonical tool id, yielding a deterministic total order.

For the first not-yet-disqualified route in total order, V4 probes one unknown required capability; each truthful receipt strictly reduces that route's finite unknown-capability set or disqualifies it.

By induction over the finite ordered admissible route list, V4 cannot advance past a cheaper route while it may still satisfy all requirements; therefore the first SELECT is exactly the global least-cost sufficient route in the complete common boundary.
If no admissible route is sufficient, finite truthful probing eventually gives every admissible route a negative required-capability witness and V4 returns ESCALATE only after complete discovery.

The adapter preserves visible identities, discovery receipts and safe probe receipts across later tasks in the same epoch; V4's epoch-bound evidence map reuses them and does not re-probe already known capability facts.

V4 treats a capability as positive only from a current-epoch SAFE_CAPABILITY_PROBE receipt with supported true; the adapter emits that bit only from private harness truth, so no unsupported capability-state promotion can be created.

A material ecosystem change creates a fresh adapter decision epoch with no inherited probe receipts; hence evidence transfer is valid only within the frozen epoch and stale capability state cannot cross the change.
